slow_update_content: Before submitting, check that the answer gives the requested relation and uses the right name form—not merely that it is semantically related. For a bare ruler/person clue whose target relation is a country, give the country alone (e.g., Brunei), not the title. When an unambiguous person is referred to in a shortened form, preserve that form (e.g., George Bush); do not add initials, suffixes, honorifics, or longer name expansions unless requested or needed to disambiguate. For named works and places, avoid interchangeable expansions or silent spelling changes; verify the conventional form, including spacing, number, and any essential article. In these clue forms, use Showboat rather than Show Boat, Bagpipes rather than bagpipe, and the Adirondacks rather than Adirondack Mountains. For comparisons, honor the exact property and time scope; for technical clues, respect explicit category distinctions such as acid versus alkali; for linked-media clues, trace the named role to the specific work asked for rather than an adjacent work.
